notes: Eclipse Loop 2.5.9 Your AudioUnits are back If you own a plugin as both AU and VST3, the AU has been hidden from every picker in the app since 7 July. The scanner collapsed duplicates by name and let VST3 win. The two formats are not interchangeable - some plugins are stable as one and not the other - so both are listed again. Plugins are scanned when Eclipse Loop opens The plugin list used to come from a cache file that nothing ever updated, so plugins you removed stayed listed and plugins you installed never appeared. The scan now runs in a separate process, so a plugin that hangs or crashes cannot take Eclipse Loop down with it - it gets skipped and the scan carries on. If you use Waves or an iLok, you have seen exactly this kind of hang. You can turn it off: Settings - Project - Scan plugins at startup. There is a Rescan Plugins Now button beside it. A plugin that cannot load now tells you why. An older Intel-only plugin on an Apple Silicon Mac says so, instead of reporting that it could not be found. Recording quality Recordings were being written at 16-bit. They are 24-bit now
